product_one_liner.value: Momentus provides SaaS event and venue management software for event professionals and venue operators to streamline operations, manage bookings, and grow venue revenue.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes a venue and event management platform used to improve bookings, operations, and venue revenue; the company’s job-page description identifies event professionals as its users.

pricing_page.notes: The company has a public /pricing page explaining that cost depends on scope, which qualifies as a public pricing page even without fixed prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company homepage names Google, Microsoft, and Nike in its “Trusted by” customer proof. | named_customers.0: The company homepage names Google as a customer. | named_customers.1: The company homepage names Microsoft as a customer. | named_customers.2: The company homepage names Nike as a customer.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn gives the company an employee band of 201–500, consistent with PitchBook’s reported 416 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s LinkedIn profile and PitchBook profile place headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. | hq_country: The company profile places headquarters in the United States, and its LinkedIn profile specifies St. Louis, Missouri.

founded_year.notes: The company profile says Momentus was founded in 1985.

eng_blog.notes: The complete blog index is a broad venue/event insights and company-news blog. The index and author page show one qualifying engineering-oriented post by Dave Walden, who leads Platform Engineering and Site Reliability Engineering; the other nearby technical-sounding post is by the Chief Product Officer, not an engineer. This does not meet the two-engineer-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: Momentus provides public API documentation links and documentation for multiple API collections, including Enterprise OData, Enterprise Standard, and Elite APIs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers inventory says 7 of 7 openings and lists them all; none has AI, ML, data science, or a related qualifying title. An older direct AI Operations Manager page remains accessible, but it is absent from the current complete job-board inventory, so the current status is treated as false.

model_provider.value: AWS Bedrock, which provides access to foundation models from Anthropic, Meta, Amazon, Cohere, and others.
model_provider.notes: Momentus Answers states that the AI products run on AWS Bedrock and names the model providers it makes available.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Momentus Trust Center compliance list names SOC 2, ISO 27001:2022, and PCI DSS; the ticketing page separately claims GDPR compliance. No HIPAA claim is cited. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center compliance list explicitly names SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center compliance list explicitly names ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center compliance list explicitly names PCI DSS. | compliance_certs.3: The ticketing page claims GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook identifies the most recent financing deal type as Debt - Acquisition and Acquisition Financing. | funding_date: PitchBook reports the latest financing date as 2026-01-05, which is represented as 2026-01 in the requested YYYY-MM format. | funding_amount_usd: PitchBook reports the latest financing size as USD 27.694 million; converting that reported amount gives 27,694,000 USD.

raised_18mo.notes: The reported latest financing is dated January 5, 2026, within the 18-month interval ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current first-party SmartRecruiters posting is titled Account Executive and describes the sales-team role.

launched_6mo.notes: The MomentusMAX and MAX for Sales launch was announced on September 15, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The January 2026 company announcement records C-level appointments, within the 12 months before the stated run date.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Sales Operations Analyst posting explicitly names Salesforce, HubSpot, and Gong as sales technology platforms. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting names Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job posting names Hubspot. | crm_stack_signal.2: The job posting names Gong.
